If you're looking for fun and easy April Fools' prank ideas, you've come to the right place. At Nuts.com, we've taken "nutty" to a whole new level with pranks you can pull on family members, friends, coworkers, frenemies, and any of the other unsuspecting people in your life. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to share some laughs (and tasty treats) this April Fools’ Day! Pranks at Home These kid-friendly pranks are sure to get a few giggles from your little ones. Get the whole family in on the fun! Candy Blox $10.49/lb Add to cart Replace your kids’ Lego bricks with Candy Blox. Giant Gummy Bears $7.99 Add to cart Swap your child’s teddy bear for a giant 3.5-inch-tall gummy bear. Chocolate Rocks $14.49/lb Add to cart Pretend you found some cool rocks in the backyard, and surprise your kids when you bite into one! M&M's® $9.99/lb Add to cart Mix M&M's, Skittles, and Reese’s Pieces into one bowl. They look the same, but they all taste different! *Make sure to add our Skittles and Reese’s Pieces to your cart, too. Pranks at Work Don't let April Fool's Day be just another day at the office! Make it a day for your co-workers to remember with one of these unconventional (yet harmless) pranks. Chia Seeds $7.49/lb Add to cart Swap out the office coffee grounds for chia seeds. Jumbo Roasted Peanuts (In Shell) $4.49/lb Add to cart Deliver a 25 lb. case of peanuts to your co-worker’s desk. Neapolitan Freeze Dried Ice Cream $8.49 Add to cart Bring your co-workers astronaut ice cream instead of the usual frozen yogurt run. More April Fools' Prank Ideas Friends and significant others are some of the most fun people to prank on April Fools’ Day! Try one of these friendly tricks on them. Jumbo Medjool Dates $9.59 Add to cart Ask someone ”out for a nice date” and take them outside and give them a dried date. Freeze-Dried Spinach $8.99 Add to cart Tell your friend you’re bringing her a salad and give her a bowl of freeze-dried spinach. World's Biggest Candy Necklace $4.99 Add to cart Surprise your girlfriend with the World's Biggest Candy Necklace. Chocolate Covered Cinnamon Bears $8.49 Add to cart Give chocolate covered cinnamon bears to someone who loves chocolate, but not cinnamon.
